## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Fódà Sēngdà jīng* (T541) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Jǔqú Jīngshēng 沮渠京聲 ([沮渠京聲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B2%AE%E6%B8%A0%E4%BA%AC%E8%81%B2)). The two protagonists *Fódà* 佛大 ("Buddha-the-Great") and *Sēngdà* 僧大 ("Saṅgha-the-Great") are paired Buddhist disciples whose names emphasize their devotion to the Three Jewels.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna* narrative on the karmic stories of two devoted lay-disciples. Translation dated to Jǔqú Jīngshēng's productive period (455–464 CE).
